snippet.title: The Lullaby Weaver  | Horror Game Awards SUMMER SHOWCASE WORLD PREMIERE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
The Lullaby Weaver is a 1 bit psychological point & click horror game inspired by games like World of Horror, Silent Hill, & the works of Junji Ito & FAITH. The Lullaby Weaver takes players on a journey of self discovery after Maya loses her grandmother and returns home to settle her estate. Upon arriving at Cold Springs, not everything is as it seems. With the town seemingly empty, and unspeakable creatures roaming freely, Maya must explore, solve puzzles, and avoid getting killed by the horrors that challenge her psyche, to deal with her memories of the past and find the Lullaby Weaver, the fabled entity that could get her free of the pain she carries in her heart. 

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621450/The_Lullaby_Weaver/

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
